items.name: Web Acquisition Layer
items.reason: A deterministic, public-source, zero-cost-first acquisition router already exists on current main. Provider execution remains deliberately gated, so this is a real partial capability rather than a claim that every adapter is live.

items.name: Scrapling
items.reason: Verified OSS/local adapter candidate, but no measured gap currently justifies installing or executing it. Keep catalogued until the official/API/feed route cannot meet contract.

items.name: Crawlee
items.reason: Verified OSS/local adapter candidate. It remains catalogued rather than becoming a dependency until a concrete acquisition gap demonstrates OLD-vs-NEW benefit.

items.name: Apify Free
items.reason: The platform remains only a free-tier fallback candidate. No subscription, spend or provider binding is justified while internal/OSS routes can satisfy the zero-cost policy. Re-open only with current quota and ROI evidence.

items.name: Agent-Reach
items.reason: Useful as a research/source-adapter reference only. Do not add another runtime or execute external code unless a specific capability gap survives overlap, security and OLD-vs-NEW review.

items.name: Technology Scout automático
items.reason: Evidence-first deterministic scoring is integrated and zero-cost. Installation/execution of discovered technologies remains plan-only, which is the correct safety boundary until each candidate passes license, overlap, security and rollback gates.

items.name: COMPET continuo
items.reason: COMPET-001 exists canonically and historical evidence exists, but current main has no competitor runtime path. This is a real zero-cost gap: extend the existing engine through FACT-001/JOB-001 instead of creating a new engine or importing an external competitor tool.

items.name: WAUD
items.reason: WAUD-001 has a shared multi-company PREPROD runtime on current main with read-only outputs, evidence hashes and no PROD writes.

items.name: KW
items.reason: KW-001 has a shared multi-company PREPROD runtime on current main using declared/public signals without fabricating external metrics.

items.name: SOCAUD
items.reason: SOCAUD-001 has a shared multi-company PREPROD runtime on current main and limits audience metrics to observed public evidence.

items.name: LOCALP
items.reason: LOCALP-001 has a shared multi-company PREPROD runtime on current main for NAP/categories/review evidence with fail-closed low-confidence handling.
